cli.exec_runtime.thinking.note: Once per reasoning phase; fixed short label, no private reasoning text.

cli.exec_runtime.tool_interrupted.note: name is a sanitized opaque tool name; keep glyph; one short row.

cli.exec_runtime.tool_failed.note: name is a sanitized opaque tool name; keep glyph; one short row.

cli.exec_runtime.output_check_failed.note: format is a machine identifier; attempt/max_attempts are counts rendered without locale digit changes; reason is sanitized model-influenced prose, never markup. Keep one line and punctuation.

cli.exec_runtime.retry.note: attempt is the retry number; error is opaque error data. Preserve dim tags; short progress row.

cli.exec_runtime.model_fallback.note: selector is opaque provider/model id; complete fallback sentence, not an English verb fragment. Preserve dim tags; one row.

cli.exec_runtime.model_switched.note: selector is opaque provider/model id; deliberate switch, not recovery. Preserve dim tags; one row.

cli.exec_runtime.model_returned.note: selector is opaque provider/model id; route recovery. Preserve dim tags; one row.

cli.exec_runtime.compacting.note: Fixed short progress row; preserve dim tags and ellipsis.

cli.exec_runtime.error.note: sentence is opaque provider error plus external recovery helpers; never markup. Preserve prefix and existing wrapping.

cli.exec_runtime.aborted.note: Fixed short terminal outcome; preserve red tags.
